# Motion presets — real sample prompts from higgsfield.ai

Extracted from the public sample pages `higgsfield.ai/motion/<presetId>/<sampleId>` (crawled 2026-09-25, robots.txt respected). **1234 sample prompts across 150 presets.** Each is image-to-video: start image + preset motion + prompt. The model is given in the preset file (Wan 2.5 for sitemap presets; Minimax Hailuo 2.3 / Seedance Pro / Kling 2.5 Turbo for round-2 presets).
